goal_checks.notes: tourReset + the header control; the close path rewinds the cursor so a re-open starts at 1 / 8. PROVEN live: reopened at 1/8; the unit test '043: reopens from the first step' guards it.

A chevron beside each rail's own title folds it; the rail slides (width + transform, 300 ms) to a 45 px handle that brings it back, and the document takes the width. PROVEN live: notes 288 → 45 px and people 320 → 45 px with per-frame intermediate widths on the way, panel aria-hidden + inert while folded, area 414 → 934 px; unit tests cover both rails.

useNotesNudge speaks only while the notes rail is folded, with a 'Show notes' action that reopens it; silent outside a workspace via the tolerant context reader. PROVEN live (toast + action) and by 3 unit tests.

Four swatches; both capture paths store the chosen key; the layer resolves each row's key at render. PROVEN live: a rose mark stored bbox.color='rose' and the canvas painted rose at exactly the stored rects. Rows with color null still read as the default.

Arrows page when free and yield to inputs, contenteditable, tablists, radiogroups, sliders and any open dialog (role=dialog covers Radix's sheet). PROVEN live (1→2→1, blocked by the sheet and by an input) and by the new unit test.

The note sheet (eyebrow + scrolling body), the editor (icons, pen chip; spec'd labels kept), the writing check, the persona editor and the re-import panel all read as one system with 039; Export keeps its exact accessible name so its test and muscle memory survive.

Pages stack on a sized box on a muted ground, and the pdf.js text layer gets the vendor's own subset plus --total-scale-factor. PROVEN live: stages 399×0 → 612×792 at distinct y; spans 16 px flowed → 10.13 px positioned; a captured highlight landed on the heading it selected. This was a pre-existing defect (an older tab, loaded before this task, showed the same), not a regression.

matches — no painter touched; I19 is untouched (the fix is layout CSS, not coordinates); highlight-layer still receives normalized rects and resolves colour at render (010's rule).

issues_found: Pre-existing, found on the way: every page in the window laid out at zero height so pages 1 and 2 painted on top of each other, and the pdf.js text layer had no stylesheet (spans flowed as a paragraph). Highlight rects were captured from a layer that was not where the page was. Fixed under g7; an older tab proves it pre-dated this task.
Radix's sheet content carries role="dialog" but not aria-modal — an aria-modal-only guard would silently fail to protect the page behind it. The keyboard guard keys on the role.
React's compiler lint rejects setState inside an effect — the tour's rewind moved onto the close event, which is also the more honest place for it.
The first 'Show the tour again' implementation resumed on the last step (8/8); caught live, fixed, and covered by a unit test.
